# Data dictionary

Layers: **raw** (the 9 CSVs loaded with explicit types) → **staging** (`stg_*`, cleaned and normalised) → **marts** (`fct_*`, `dim_*`, what analytics read). Row counts are from the real data (results/data_quality/report.json). See [architecture.md](architecture.md) for the ER diagram and the pipeline.

## Raw layer

### `customers` (99,441 rows)

Source `olist_customers_dataset.csv`. One row per order-level customer_id; customer_unique_id is the person.

| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| `customer_id` | TEXT |
| `customer_unique_id` | TEXT |
| `customer_zip_code_prefix` | TEXT |
| `customer_city` | TEXT |
| `customer_state` | TEXT |

## Staging layer

### `stg_customers` (99,441 rows)

**Grain:** one row per customer_id (Olist issues a new customer_id for every order; customer_unique_id identifies the person).  
**Purpose:** normalised customer attributes.  
**Depends on:** `customers`

zip prefixes are left-padded to 5 digits (the CSV dropped the leading zero of 23,995 customers, so they never matched the geolocation table); city lower-cased and trimmed; state upper-cased and trimmed.

Columns: `customer_id`, `customer_unique_id`, `zip_prefix`, `city`, `state`

### `stg_geolocation` (19,010 rows)

**Grain:** one row per 5-digit zip prefix.  
**Purpose:** one coordinate per zip prefix, for distances between seller and customer.  
**Depends on:** `geolocation`

the raw table has 1,000,163 rows for 19,015 prefixes (many duplicates and a few points outside Brazil). Points outside Brazil's bounding box are dropped and the remaining points are reduced to their median latitude and longitude.

Columns: `zip_prefix`, `lat`, `lng`, `state`, `n_points`

### `stg_order_items` (112,650 rows)

**Grain:** one row per (order_id, order_item_id): one row per unit sold.  
**Purpose:** line items with price and freight kept separate.  
**Depends on:** `order_items`

none beyond renaming; price is the item price paid to the seller and freight_value the shipping charged for that item (Olist splits an order's freight across its items).

Columns: `order_id`, `order_item_id`, `product_id`, `seller_id`, `shipping_limit_at`, `price`, `freight_value`

### `stg_order_payments` (103,886 rows)

**Grain:** one row per (order_id, payment_sequential).  
**Purpose:** payments as recorded by the payment provider.  
**Depends on:** `order_payments`

payment_type lower-cased; 2 rows with 0 instalments are set to 1 (a payment is at least one instalment). 'not_defined' (3 rows, value 0) is kept.

Columns: `order_id`, `payment_sequential`, `payment_type`, `installments`, `payment_value`

### `stg_order_reviews` (99,224 rows)

**Grain:** one row per (review_id, order_id). The raw review_id is NOT unique: 789 review ids are attached to more than one order (one survey answered for several orders), and 547 orders have more than one review.  
**Purpose:** review scores with the timestamps that matter for leakage-safe features.  
**Depends on:** `order_reviews`

exact duplicate (review_id, order_id) rows are dropped, keeping the latest answer; has_comment marks a non-empty comment.

Columns: `review_id`, `order_id`, `review_score`, `has_comment`, `comment_message`, `survey_sent_at`, `answered_at`

### `stg_orders` (99,441 rows)

**Grain:** one row per order_id.  
**Purpose:** order header with normalised dates, status flags and data-quality flags.  
**Depends on:** `orders`

status lower-cased; purchase date and month derived once here so every downstream model buckets time the same way; is_cancelled covers both 'canceled' and 'unavailable' (neither became a sale); is_delivered needs status 'delivered' AND a delivery timestamp (8 'delivered' orders have none). dq_* flags keep known timestamp anomalies visible instead of silently dropping the rows.

Columns: `order_id`, `customer_id`, `order_status`, `purchased_at`, `approved_at`, `shipped_at`, `delivered_at`, `estimated_delivery_at`, `purchase_date`, `purchase_month`, `is_cancelled`, `is_delivered`, `dq_shipped_before_approved`, `dq_delivered_before_shipped`, `dq_delivered_without_date`

### `stg_products` (32,951 rows)

**Grain:** one row per product_id.  
**Purpose:** products with an English category and physical attributes.  
**Depends on:** `products`, `category_translation`

category translated to English; the two categories missing from the translation table are translated here; the 610 products without a category get 'unknown'. The source column names are misspelt (lenght) and are renamed. Volume is length x height x width.

Columns: `product_id`, `category_pt`, `category`, `name_length`, `description_length`, `photos_qty`, `weight_g`, `length_cm`, `height_cm`, `width_cm`, `volume_cm3`

### `stg_sellers` (3,095 rows)

**Grain:** one row per seller_id.  
**Purpose:** normalised seller attributes.  
**Depends on:** `sellers`

zip prefix left-padded to 5 digits (1,027 sellers had lost the leading zero), city lower-cased and trimmed, state upper-cased and trimmed.

Columns: `seller_id`, `zip_prefix`, `city`, `state`

## Marts layer

### `dim_products` (32,951 rows)

**Grain:** one row per product_id.  
**Purpose:** the product dimension analytics read (category in English, size, weight).  
**Depends on:** `stg_products`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | VARCHAR | Product identifier. |
| `category` | VARCHAR | Product category in English ('unknown' when the product has none). |
| `category_pt` | VARCHAR | Original Portuguese category name. |
| `name_length` | INTEGER | Characters in the product name (source column product_name_lenght). |
| `description_length` | INTEGER | Characters in the description. |
| `photos_qty` | INTEGER | Number of product photos. |
| `weight_g` | INTEGER | Product weight in grams. |
| `length_cm` | INTEGER | Package length in cm. |
| `height_cm` | INTEGER | Package height in cm. |
| `width_cm` | INTEGER | Package width in cm. |
| `volume_cm3` | INTEGER | Product volume (length x height x width) in cm3. |

### `fct_orders` (99,441 rows)

**Grain:** one row per order_id (every order, including cancelled ones; filter on is_valid).  
**Purpose:** the single source of truth for order-level money, delivery, review and customer sequence. Analytics queries and the metric layer read this table instead of re-deriving order value from the raw tables.  
**Depends on:** `stg_orders`, `stg_order_items`, `stg_order_payments`, `stg_order_reviews`, `stg_customers`, `stg_products`, `stg_sellers`, `stg_geolocation`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | VARCHAR | Order identifier (one per checkout). |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR | Per-order customer key issued by Olist (a person gets a new one per order). |
| `customer_unique_id` | VARCHAR | The person behind the order; use it for customer analytics. |
| `customer_state` | VARCHAR | Two-letter state of the customer's address on the order. |
| `customer_zip_prefix` | VARCHAR | Customer zip prefix on this order, left-padded to 5 digits. |
| `order_status` | VARCHAR | Olist order status (delivered, shipped, canceled, unavailable, ...). |
| `is_cancelled` | INTEGER | 1 if the status is canceled or unavailable (never became a sale). |
| `is_valid` | INTEGER | 1 for a sale - not cancelled/unavailable and at least one item. Filter on it. |
| `is_delivered` | INTEGER | 1 if status is delivered AND a delivery timestamp exists. |
| `purchased_at` | TIMESTAMP | Purchase timestamp. |
| `approved_at` | TIMESTAMP | Payment approval timestamp. |
| `shipped_at` | TIMESTAMP | Hand-over to the carrier. |
| `delivered_at` | TIMESTAMP | Delivery to the customer. |
| `estimated_delivery_at` | TIMESTAMP | Delivery date promised at checkout. |
| `purchase_date` | DATE | Purchase date. |
| `purchase_month` | DATE | First day of the purchase month. |
| `n_items` | BIGINT | Items (units) in the order. |
| `n_products` | BIGINT | Distinct products in the order. |
| `n_sellers` | BIGINT | Distinct sellers in the order (1,278 real orders have more than one). |
| `item_revenue` | DOUBLE | Sum of item prices (merchandise value paid to sellers); excludes freight. |
| `freight_value` | DOUBLE | Freight charged to the customer. |
| `gmv` | DOUBLE | Gross merchandise value = item_revenue + freight_value. |
| `payment_value` | DOUBLE | Amount charged by the payment provider (includes instalment interest, vouchers). |
| `n_payments` | BIGINT | Payment records of the order. |
| `installments` | INTEGER | Number of instalments (largest across the order's payments; 0 fixed to 1). |
| `main_payment_type` | VARCHAR | Payment type of the largest payment. |
| `used_voucher` | INTEGER | 1 if any payment is a voucher. |
| `main_product_id` | VARCHAR | Product of item 1. |
| `main_seller_id` | VARCHAR | Seller of item 1 (used for lanes and seller history). |
| `category` | VARCHAR | Category of item 1 (use fct_order_items for exact category revenue). |
| `main_product_weight_g` | INTEGER | Weight of item 1's product in grams. |
| `main_product_volume_cm3` | INTEGER | Volume of item 1's product in cm3. |
| `seller_state` | VARCHAR | State of the seller of item 1. |
| `review_score` | DOUBLE | Review score 1-5 (mean when an order has several reviews). |
| `n_reviews` | BIGINT | Number of reviews attached to the order. |
| `review_sent_at` | TIMESTAMP | When the satisfaction survey was sent (first review). |
| `review_answered_at` | TIMESTAMP | When the last review answer arrived (the score is known from then). |
| `has_comment` | INTEGER | 1 if the review(s) include a comment. |
| `customer_lat` | DOUBLE | Latitude of the customer's zip prefix. |
| `customer_lng` | DOUBLE | Longitude of the customer's zip prefix. |
| `seller_lat` | DOUBLE | Latitude of the main seller's zip prefix. |
| `seller_lng` | DOUBLE | Longitude of the main seller's zip prefix. |
| `dq_shipped_before_approved` | INTEGER | Data-quality flag - carrier hand-over before approval. |
| `dq_delivered_before_shipped` | INTEGER | Data-quality flag - delivery before carrier hand-over. |
| `payment_minus_gmv` | DOUBLE | payment_value - gmv (interest, vouchers, rounding). |
| `delivery_days` | BIGINT | Calendar days from purchase to delivery (delivered orders only). |
| `estimated_days` | BIGINT | Days from purchase to the promised date. |
| `delay_days` | BIGINT | Delivered date minus estimated date in days (positive = late). |
| `is_late` | INTEGER | 1 if delivered after the estimated date, 0 if on time; NULL when not delivered. |
| `handling_days` | BIGINT | Days from approval to carrier hand-over. |
| `carrier_days` | BIGINT | Days from carrier hand-over to delivery. |
| `distance_km` | DOUBLE | Great-circle distance between the main seller's and the customer's zip prefix. |
| `same_state` | INTEGER | 1 if customer and main seller are in the same state. |
| `customer_order_seq` | BIGINT | 1 for the person's first valid order, 2 for the second, ... (NULL if invalid). |
| `cohort_month` | DATE | Month of the person's first valid order ever (acquisition cohort). |
| `customer_first_purchase_at` | TIMESTAMP | Timestamp of the person's first valid order. |
| `is_repeat_order` | INTEGER | 1 for a person's second or later valid order. |

### `dim_customers` (96,096 rows)

**Grain:** one row per customer_unique_id (a person), including people whose only orders were cancelled (n_orders = 0, cohort_month NULL).  
**Purpose:** customer attributes, acquisition cohort and lifetime totals over valid orders.  
**Depends on:** `stg_customers`, `fct_orders`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_unique_id` | VARCHAR | The person behind the order; use it for customer analytics. |
| `customer_state` | VARCHAR | State of the person's first valid order. |
| `zip_prefix` | VARCHAR | Zip prefix of the person's first valid order. |
| `cohort_month` | DATE | Month of the person's first valid order ever (acquisition cohort). |
| `first_order_at` | TIMESTAMP | First valid order timestamp. |
| `last_order_at` | TIMESTAMP | Last valid order timestamp. |
| `n_orders` | BIGINT | Valid orders of the person (0 if all were cancelled). |
| `lifetime_gmv` | DOUBLE | GMV of the person's valid orders (observed value to date). |
| `lifetime_item_revenue` | DOUBLE | Item revenue of the person's valid orders. |
| `avg_review` | DOUBLE | Mean review of the person's valid orders. |
| `is_repeat_customer` | INTEGER | 1 if the person has 2+ valid orders. |

### `fct_order_items` (112,650 rows)

**Grain:** one row per (order_id, order_item_id).  
**Purpose:** item-level sales for category and seller analytics. An order can span several sellers (1,278 orders) and categories (727 orders), so seller and category revenue must be summed here, not from fct_orders' main seller/category.  
**Depends on:** `stg_order_items`, `stg_products`, `stg_sellers`, `fct_orders`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | VARCHAR | Order identifier (one per checkout). |
| `order_item_id` | INTEGER | Position of the item within its order (1, 2, ...); one row per unit sold. |
| `product_id` | VARCHAR | Product identifier. |
| `seller_id` | VARCHAR | Seller identifier. |
| `category` | VARCHAR | Category of this item's product. |
| `seller_state` | VARCHAR | State of this item's seller. |
| `customer_unique_id` | VARCHAR | The person behind the order; use it for customer analytics. |
| `customer_state` | VARCHAR | Two-letter state of the customer's address on the order. |
| `order_status` | VARCHAR | Olist order status (delivered, shipped, canceled, unavailable, ...). |
| `is_valid` | INTEGER | 1 for a sale - not cancelled/unavailable and at least one item. Filter on it. |
| `is_cancelled` | INTEGER | 1 if the status is canceled or unavailable (never became a sale). |
| `is_delivered` | INTEGER | 1 if status is delivered AND a delivery timestamp exists. |
| `purchased_at` | TIMESTAMP | Purchase timestamp. |
| `purchase_month` | DATE | First day of the purchase month. |
| `delivery_days` | BIGINT | Calendar days from purchase to delivery (delivered orders only). |
| `delay_days` | BIGINT | Delivered date minus estimated date in days (positive = late). |
| `is_late` | INTEGER | Lateness of the order this item belongs to. |
| `review_score` | DOUBLE | Review score of the order this item belongs to. |
| `item_revenue` | DOUBLE | Price of this item. |
| `freight_value` | DOUBLE | Freight charged for this item. |
| `gmv` | DOUBLE | price + freight of this item. |
| `weight_g` | INTEGER | Product weight in grams. |
| `volume_cm3` | INTEGER | Product volume (length x height x width) in cm3. |

### `fct_payments` (103,886 rows)

**Grain:** one row per (order_id, payment_sequential).  
**Purpose:** payment-method analytics with the order's validity flag and purchase month.  
**Depends on:** `stg_order_payments`, `fct_orders`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | VARCHAR | Order identifier (one per checkout). |
| `payment_sequential` | INTEGER | Sequence of the payment within the order. |
| `payment_type` | VARCHAR | credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card or not_defined. |
| `installments` | INTEGER | Instalments of this payment (0 fixed to 1). |
| `payment_value` | DOUBLE | Amount of this payment. |
| `is_valid` | INTEGER | 1 for a sale - not cancelled/unavailable and at least one item. Filter on it. |
| `is_cancelled` | INTEGER | 1 if the status is canceled or unavailable (never became a sale). |
| `purchase_month` | DATE | First day of the purchase month. |
| `customer_state` | VARCHAR | Two-letter state of the customer's address on the order. |

### `fct_reviews` (99,224 rows)

**Grain:** one row per (review_id, order_id).  
**Purpose:** review text and score with the order's delivery outcome, for review analytics.  
**Depends on:** `stg_order_reviews`, `fct_orders`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | VARCHAR | Survey identifier (not unique on its own - one survey can cover several orders). |
| `order_id` | VARCHAR | Order identifier (one per checkout). |
| `review_score` | INTEGER | Score 1-5 of this review. |
| `has_comment` | INTEGER | 1 if the review(s) include a comment. |
| `comment_message` | VARCHAR | Free-text comment (Portuguese), NULL if none. |
| `survey_sent_at` | TIMESTAMP | When the survey was sent. |
| `answered_at` | TIMESTAMP | When the customer answered. |
| `is_valid` | INTEGER | 1 for a sale - not cancelled/unavailable and at least one item. Filter on it. |
| `is_delivered` | INTEGER | 1 if status is delivered AND a delivery timestamp exists. |
| `is_late` | INTEGER | 1 if delivered after the estimated date, 0 if on time; NULL when not delivered. |
| `delay_days` | BIGINT | Delivered date minus estimated date in days (positive = late). |
| `category` | VARCHAR | Category of the order's first item. |
| `customer_state` | VARCHAR | Two-letter state of the customer's address on the order. |

### `dim_sellers` (3,095 rows)

**Grain:** one row per seller_id.  
**Purpose:** seller location (with coordinates when the zip prefix is known) and first sale.  
**Depends on:** `stg_sellers`, `stg_geolocation`, `fct_order_items`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `seller_id` | VARCHAR | Seller identifier. |
| `zip_prefix` | VARCHAR | Zip prefix, left-padded to 5 digits. |
| `city` | VARCHAR | Seller city (lower-case). |
| `state` | VARCHAR | Seller state. |
| `lat` | DOUBLE | Median latitude of the zip prefix (points outside Brazil dropped). |
| `lng` | DOUBLE | Median longitude of the zip prefix. |
| `first_sale_at` | TIMESTAMP | Purchase timestamp of the seller's first valid sale. |
